AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/PartitionSelectGesture.qml
	TRAVERSE Item#gestureHandler
		LOCATE BEFORE SelectionAction
		INSERT {
			readonly property int horizontalThreshold: 20
		}
		REPLACE SelectionAction WITH {
			enum SelectionAction {
			NoAction,
			WaitForInput,
			SelectBelow,
			SelectAbove,
			}
		}
		REPLACE _selectAction WITH {
		function _selectAction(action) {
			let lasso = undefined;
			if (action === PartitionSelectGesture.SelectionAction.SelectBelow) {
				lasso = selectOverlay.getArea(sceneRect.left, sceneRect.right, sceneRect.bottom);
				gestureHandler.selectWithLine(lasso);
			}
			if (action === PartitionSelectGesture.SelectionAction.SelectAbove) {
				lasso = selectOverlay.getArea(sceneRect.left, sceneRect.right, sceneRect.top);
				gestureHandler.selectWithLine(lasso);
			}
			_endCurrentOperation();
		}
		}
TRAVERSE SelectionContextualMenu#selectBelow
REPLACE ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button WITH {
ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
            type: ArkTokens.ContextualMenu.secondary
            focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
            iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/arrow_down"
            onClicked: _selectAction(PartitionSelectGesture.SelectionAction.SelectBelow)
        }
}
LOCATE AFTER ALL
INSERT{			
				ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
					type: ArkTokens.ContextualMenu.secondary
					focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
					iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/arrow_up"
					onClicked: _selectAction(PartitionSelectGesture.SelectionAction.SelectAbove)
				}						
			}
			
	END TRAVERSE
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
